description: 10 phrasings of the same NEMA 17 mount request. All must extract to the same facts: nema17_face + extrusion_2020_slot interfaces, 4mm walls, PLA, 60x60x40 envelope.
variants: Design a 3D-printable mounting bracket for a NEMA 17 stepper motor. The bracket mounts the motor to a 2020 aluminum extrusion using two M5 T-nuts. Wall thickness 4mm. Motor shaft faces away from the extrusion. The finished part must fit within a 60 x 60 x 40 mm bounding box. Material: PLA.
I need a PLA bracket that holds a NEMA 17 stepper and bolts onto a 2020 extrusion with M5 T-nuts. Keep the walls 4mm and the whole thing under 60x60x40mm.
Make me a motor mount: NEMA 17 on one side, attaches to a 20x20 aluminium rail via two M5 t-nuts on the other. 4 mm walls, printed in PLA, max size 60 x 60 x 40 mm.
Part: NEMA17 stepper bracket. Mounts motor and fastens to a 2020 v-slot extrusion (M5 T-nuts). Min wall 4mm. PLA. Envelope 60x60x40.
Bracket to attach a NEMA 17 stepper motor to a 2020 extrusion. Use M5 T-nuts for the rail. 4mm minimum wall thickness, PLA material, must stay within a 60mm x 60mm x 40mm box.

Stepper motor mount for a NEMA 17, bolting to 2020 aluminum profile with two M5 T-nuts. Walls at least 4mm thick. PLA. Bounding box no larger than 60 x 60 x 40 mm.
